reviewNotes: Vicefold is an unofficial fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI (released Nov 19, 2026). All text in the app is written by us from public facts (mission names, character names, cheat codes); no game art, logos or screenshots are included. The map is the GTA VI Community Map by Yanis and the GTADB.org community, used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license and credited on the map and in Settings > About. The rare vehicle pins on the map (name and position only) come from Open GTA 6 Map, also under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, credited in the map credits; players can vote on each one ("It's here" / "Not here"), add a rare vehicle they found (car icon on the map) and discuss it; this uses the existing community system, with the same rules to accept first, word filter, report (hidden after 3 reports) and block. The app clearly states it is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive (Settings > About, Home screen footer, description). No account is needed. "Watch it on YouTube" in a mission only opens a YouTube search in YouTube or Safari; nothing is embedded or downloaded. Optional PlayStation play time (Pro): the user signs in on Sony's own page in a web view; we never see the password, and only read the user's own game list and play time, stored on the device. Pro (one-time or subscription) unlocks map extras, iCloud sync and widgets; every guide is free. Music previews come from Apple's public iTunes Search API and link to Apple Music.
